title: Solana public CA Helius live smoke acceptance
objective: Run one manually invoked, bounded, read-only Helius smoke against one public Solana CA chosen by the coordinator. Prove finalized mint, token metadata, and a non-truncated holder account response without retaining raw provider payloads or writing to a production database.
forbidden_actions: Do not print, store, commit or record credentials, bearer values, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
Do not call a provider other than Helius.
Do not activate BSC, Robinhood, scheduler, cron, background loops, automated token discovery, or production database writes.
Do not claim deep Pump creator, Dev-history, wallet-tag, or wallet-fact coverage from this bounded smoke.
